method.where: k8s Job inside the EKS cluster, against the fern-bench Deployment
method.bank: simulated (in-process, Column-like contract); the Column sandbox is not load tested
method.database: the same RDS instance, separate database fern_bench
method.note: Capacity is set by the database: RDS db.t4g.micro (2 burstable vCPUs, Multi-AZ, the smallest class) reached 85-95% CPU from 100 VUs, while the API pods were not the limit. Throughput levels off at about 165 req/s and falls at 200 VUs as queries queue for CPU. Each write also stores its trace, the largest single DB cost. Next steps: a larger DB class, or writing traces asynchronously.
